children.name: Puccinia
children.description: Puccinia — a genus of pucciniaceae in the family Pucciniaceae.

children.name: Puccinia arachidis
children.description: Puccinia arachidis, or peanut rust, is a plant pathogen that causes rust on peanut.

children.name: Puccinia aristidae
children.description: Puccinia aristidae is a plant pathogen that causes rust on Aristida, spinach and primula.

children.name: Puccinia asparagi
children.description: Puccinia asparagi is the causative agent of asparagus rust.

children.name: Puccinia campanulae
children.description: Puccinia campanulae is a plant pathogen that causes rust on bellflower (Campanula).

children.name: Puccinia coronata
children.description: Puccinia coronata is a plant pathogen and causal agent of oat and barley crown rust.

children.name: Puccinia dioicae
children.description: Puccinia dioicae is a plant pathogen that causes rust on goldenrod.

children.name: Puccinia hordei
children.description: Puccinia hordei is a species of rust fungus.

children.name: Puccinia horiana
children.description: Puccinia horiana is a species of fungus that causes chrysanthemum white rust, is a disease of plant species of the genus Chrysanthemum.

children.name: Puccinia lagenophorae
children.description: Puccinia lagenophorae is a rust fungus which infects plants in the family Asteraceae, particularly Senecio squalidus and Senecio vulgaris.

children.name: Puccinia liliacearum
children.description: Puccinia liliacearum is a fungal species and is commonly found as rust on Ornithogalum species.

children.name: Puccinia malvacearum
children.description: Puccinia malvacearum, also known as hollyhock or mallow rust, is a fungal species within the genus Puccinia known for attacking members of the family Malvaceae.

children.name: Puccinia melanocephala
children.description: Puccinia melanocephala is a fungus and plant pathogen, it is the causal agent of sugarcane rust.

children.name: Puccinia menthae
children.description: Puccinia menthae is a fungal plant pathogen that causes rust on mint plants.

children.name: Puccinia monoica
children.description: Puccinia monoica is a parasitic rust fungus of the genus Puccinia that inhibits flowering in its host plant (usually a Boechera species) and radically transforms host morphology in order to facilitate its own sexual reproduction by producing structures resembling flowers but containing fungal particles instead of pollen.

children.name: Puccinia myrsiphylli
children.description: Puccinia myrsiphylli is a rust fungus in the genus Puccinia, family Pucciniaceae, and is native to South Africa.

children.name: Puccinia namua
children.description: Puccinia namua is a species of rust fungus on Leptocarpus in New Zealand.

children.name: Puccinia oxalidis
children.description: Puccinia oxalidis is a fungus species in the genus Puccinia.

children.name: Puccinia poarum
children.description: Puccinia poarum, a species of fungus, known as the coltsfoot gall rust, or meadow grass rust, is a plant pathogen.

children.name: Puccinia porri
children.description: Puccinia porri (previously known as Puccinia allii) is a species of rust fungus that causes leek rust.

children.name: Puccinia purpurea
children.description: Puccinia purpurea is a fungal species and plant pathogen that causes rust on sorghum.

children.name: Puccinia recondita
children.description: Puccinia recondita is a fungus species and plant pathogen belonging to the order of Pucciniales and family Pucciniaceae.

children.name: Puccinia sessilis
children.description: Puccinia sessilis is a fungal species and plant pathogen, which is also known as arum rust or ramsons rust.

children.name: Puccinia smyrnii
children.description: Puccinia smyrnii, or alexanders rust, is a fungus species and plant pathogen which causes rust on alexanders (Smyrnium olusatrum).

children.name: Puccinia sorghi
children.description: Puccinia sorghi, or common rust of maize, is a species of rust fungus that infects corn and species from the plant genus Oxalis.

children.name: Puccinia sparganioides
children.description: Puccinia sparganioides is a parasitic fungus that causes rust disease on plants, including Spartina alterniflora.

children.name: Puccinia thaliae
children.description: Puccinia thaliae is the causal agent of canna rust, a fungal disease of Canna.

children.name: Puccinia umbilici
children.description: Puccinia umbilici is a fungal plant pathogen which causes rust on navelwort (Umbilicus rupestris).

children.name: Puccinia whakatipu
children.description: Puccinia whakatipu is a species of rust fungus on Leptocarpus in New Zealand.
